title: Which stage for an e-commerce packshot?
body: For e-commerce product packshots (accessories, beauty, small objects), the **Eclipse** stage is the best fit: motorised 4-axis rotation system, AutoAlpha™ automatic clipping, output as JPG/PNG/TIFF (video MP4/MOV on request). For flat-laid garments or staged product compositions, switch to the **Horizontal** stage (Canon EOS R · motorised 24–105 mm, automatic clipping). Plan a half-day for ~60–80 references on Eclipse, a full day for larger volumes.

title: Which stage for jewelry shoots?
body: For jewelry or small leather goods, **Eclipse** is the right pick: High-CRI continuous LED lighting, full 360° rotating platform, iPad control for repeatable shots. Clipping is automatic via AutoAlpha™. Plan a half-day for 20–40 SKUs. For a volume above 60 SKUs, book a full day.

title: Which stage for footwear?
body: For shoes and accessories, the **Eclipse** stage is dedicated: 360° rotation system, 4 motorised axes, calibrated continuous light. Perfect for producing every angle and short product-page videos. Plan ~50 pairs/day. For an on-model campaign, switch to **Live**.

title: Do you shoot ghost mannequin?
body: Yes. The **Vertical** stage is built for ghost mannequin (garment on invisible mannequin) and full-height piqué. Camera Canon EOS R · motorised 70–200 mm, automatic clipping. Plan ~60–80 pieces/day depending on complexity. Delivery as JPG/PNG/TIFF/RAW ready for e-commerce.

title: Flat-laid garment / textile packshot?
body: For flat-laid garments, knitwear or product compositions, the **Horizontal** stage is dedicated: Canon EOS R · motorised 24–105 mm (vertical), High-CRI continuous LED lighting, AutoAlpha™ automatic clipping. Plan ~80–120 pieces/day. Ideal for linesheets or large product-page batches.

title: On-model fashion shoot?
body: For on-model fashion (e-commerce, lookbook, linesheet on model), the **Live** stage is dedicated to on-model shooting and live broadcast (e-commerce + video). Continuous lighting, optional live-stream setup. Bring your crew: photographer, stylist, model(s) — crew can be sourced on request. Stage rate from **€450/day (excl. VAT)**, external crew not included.

title: Beauty / cosmetics photo & video?
body: For beauty products (bottles, sticks, lipsticks, fragrance), **Eclipse** combines rotating packshot and short video (360° rotation, macro close-ups). For an on-model campaign, switch to **Live** or **Cyclorama** depending on the lighting setup needed.

title: Campaign, editorial or commercial film?
body: For a campaign, editorial or commercial film, the **Cyclorama** is the right stage: 240 m² floor with a 2-sided 32 m² cyclo, blackout skydomes, 3.5 m × 4.5 m loading dock. Broncolor studio, 63A 3-phase electricity, high-speed Wi-Fi, 2 fitting rooms, 2 make-up stations, fully equipped kitchen. Half-day **€650**, full day **€880** (excl. VAT).

title: Food / culinary photography?
body: For food photography, the **Horizontal** stage handles top-shots, flat-lays and plated compositions. For a more staged scene (set table, atmosphere), move to the **Cyclorama**, which has a fully equipped kitchen on-site for prep and styling. Plan to bring a food stylist per brief.

title: How long should I plan for a session?
body: Rough volumes on automated stages: **Eclipse** ~50–80 SKUs/day (rotating packshot), **Horizontal** ~80–120 pieces/day (flat-lay), **Vertical** ~60–80 pieces/day (ghost mannequin). On-model on **Live**: ~120–200 looks/day depending on complexity. On the **Cyclorama**, time depends on the setup (campaign, film) — plan a half-day minimum for a light setup, a day or more for a campaign. Stage rate from **€450/day (excl. VAT)**.

title: Post-production turnaround?
body: Post-production is in-house: retouching, clipping, color grading, video editing. Typical turnaround: **48–72 h** for a standard e-commerce batch (up to ~100 visuals with automatic clipping), **5–7 days** for a campaign or commercial film with advanced grading. Clipped files (AutoAlpha™ Eclipse/Horizontal/Vertical) are delivered next-day. Deliverable formats: JPG, PNG, TIFF, RAW, MP4, MOV.

title: Studio tour / discovery visit?
body: Yes: **free ~1h tour by appointment, Monday to Friday, 10am – 6pm**. **No tours on weekends** (no Saturday or Sunday). A chance to walk through the 5 stages + cyclorama, talk through your project, and estimate the right setup. To schedule, email [contact@e-do.studio](mailto:contact@e-do.studio) or use the [contact page](https://e-do.studio/en/contact) — mention "tour" in your message (the form has no topic selector).

title: Studio hours and weekend pricing?
body: E-DO Studio is open **Monday to Friday, 10am – 6pm**. **Weekend sessions (Saturday and Sunday) are available on request only**, with a **25% surcharge** on the stage rate. To plan a weekend slot, email [contact@e-do.studio](mailto:contact@e-do.studio) — each request is reviewed case-by-case based on crew availability.

title: What's in the contact form?
body: The [contact form](https://e-do.studio/en/contact) is **free-form**: name, phone, email, company/brand, and a message. **There is no topic selector** (no "studio tour", "quote", etc. dropdown) — just describe what you need in the message. For a complex project or a tour, you can also email [contact@e-do.studio](mailto:contact@e-do.studio) directly.

title: Can I combine several stages in one day?
body: Yes, this is common: **Eclipse** packshot in the morning + on-model **Live** in the afternoon, or ghost **Vertical** + flat-lay **Horizontal** in a single day. The booking configurator lets you combine multiple sessions in the same quote. Each stage is billed separately. Good way to make a single crew day worth it.

title: What to bring for shoot day?
body: The studio provides the **stage, machines, lighting, technical operator** and post-production. On your side: the **products** or samples (labeled when volumes are high), your **creative crew** (AD, stylist, model, MUA — can be sourced on request), a **visual brief** or references. On-site parking, 3.5 m × 4.5 m H loading dock. For a detailed brief, email [contact@e-do.studio](mailto:contact@e-do.studio).

title: How do I book a studio day?
body: The [booking page](https://e-do.studio/en/book) has a 7-step configurator: project type, stage(s), duration, crew, post-production options, contact, date + arrival time. The quote is generated automatically and you receive an email confirmation. For a complex case (multi-day campaign, custom setup), email [contact@e-do.studio](mailto:contact@e-do.studio) directly.
